title: Caterpillar: public fork-based poisoned pipeline execution
description: A Jenkins test pipeline builds every pull request to the public Wonderland/caterpillar repository on Gitea, including pull requests from forks, and exposes a write-scoped Gitea token to each build. With only a plain account, leak that token from a fork pull request, then use it to poison main so the prod pipeline exfiltrates the flag2 credential (OWASP CICD-SEC-4, public fork-based Poisoned Pipeline Execution).
question: Submit the value of the flag2 credential, exfiltrated through the prod pipeline after leaking the write token from a fork pull request, exactly as recovered.
